name: codol
title: Call of Duty Online (CODOL)
note: Tencent's IW4 spin-off, 32-bit, final build 3.19.26.22. Exe: the decrypted codoMP_client_shipRetail.exe (code sections entropy 6.76), flattened (file offset == RVA). Fast files inside the install's .ifs archives (install_ifs), sealed (Games/CODOL/SealedFastFile.h).
rva_note: read off the dump: DB_ReadXFile 0x484a00 (dst eax, size ecx) is the file read the loaders call, Load_Stream being inlined into every one (`cmp [block_index], 2`: block 2, runtime, is zeroed; every other block reads); Load_XStringCustom 0x4a0c80 (eax: the field) inlines the read too, one byte at a time through the zstream refill 0x4834f0 (stream.fill); DB_PushStreamPos 0x4a0ba0 (eax) and DB_PopStreamPos 0x4a0c00; DB_InsertPointer 0x4a0c50 pushes 3, aligns 4, takes 4 bytes, pops; a back reference is resolved inline: block = (v - 1) >> 28 into the block table, offset = (v - 1) & 0xfffffff; COL_DB_LoadXFile 0x483db0 sets the stream globals inline

asset_dispatch.note: Load_XAssetHeader: compares varXAsset->type and calls the type's Load_<T>Ptr with its var set to varXAssetHeader; Load_XAssetArray 0x483d20 reads count x 16 bytes {type, ?, header, ?} and dispatches each

stream.growing_blocks_note: the recording (515 zones): blocks 3 (virtual, 1 825 110 reads), 6 (vertex, 31 662) and 7 (index, 28 900) only grow; block 0 (temp) is rewound by every pop into it (94 959 of 127 808 reads below an earlier one); 1, 4 and 5 hold nothing
stream.derive_with_empties_note: blocks derive applies empties.txt: without it the 250 leaderboarddef names after an empty stringtable were charged its alignment (a string never aligns)
